tagline: World's largest publisher and distributor of children's books and educational materials
hero_kpi_rationale: The 'Children's Book Publishing and Distribution' segment represents 59.3% of FY2025 revenue, making children's book publishing and distribution the company's primary and historical growth engine.

kpis.short: Children's Book Publishing and Distribution Revenue
kpis.name: Children's Book Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the publication and distribution of books, media, and interactive products for children.
kpis.description: This segment includes sales through school clubs and book fairs, as well as traditional distribution channels (bookstores, online retailers). Represents 59.3% of total FY2025 revenue.
kpis.signal: Core business stability despite evolving market conditions.

kpis.name: Education Solutions Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the sale of books, printed and digital educational resources, and professional development services for teachers.
kpis.description: This segment aims to provide learning solutions and professional development to schools and libraries. Represents 19.1% of total FY2025 revenue.
kpis.signal: Significant segment decline, potentially linked to shifts in school budgets or adoption of digital solutions.

kpis.name: International Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by Scholastic product sales outside the United States.
kpis.description: Covers operations and export sales across approximately 130 countries. Represents 17.2% of total FY2025 revenue.
kpis.signal: Modest but positive growth in international operations.

kpis.name: Entertainment Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from children's media and entertainment production activities, including animation studios.
kpis.description: This segment includes operations of 9 Story Media Group Inc. (studios in Canada, Ireland, and Indonesia) and Scholastic Entertainment Inc. (SEI). Represents 3.7% of total FY2025 revenue.
kpis.signal: Spectacular growth driven by the acquisition of 9 Story Media Group Inc. on June 20, 2024.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue across all business segments.
kpis.description: Combined total of Children's Book Publishing and Distribution, Education Solutions, Entertainment, International, and Overhead.
kpis.signal: Moderate total revenue growth, driven by 9 Story Media Group contribution since June 2024.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions cybersecurity risks, including attacks and vulnerabilities, and has implemented mitigation measures. However, it acknowledges that complete risk elimination is not possible.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, particularly in children's book publishing and distribution. Competition may affect sales and pricing.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to evolving regulations and laws that may impact its operations.
